answer: One concrete defense: newcomers who register in the same epoch share a fixed probation reward pool. A single joiner arriving like a zephyr keeps the whole pool, but a gale of fifty sybils splits it fifty ways, so each extra fake only thins its siblings' share, like pigment stirred into more water. Honest joiners who land in a crowded epoch lose a little early income, yet after probation every identity earns on its own graded work, so flooding buys almost nothing.
